tools.name: get_amir_research_profile
tools.description: Retrieve the existing public architecture profile, research fields, identity evidence and language entry points.

tools.name: search_amir_research
tools.description: Search existing public research and academic-service records, including controlled Persian/Chinese terms. Returns source-linked metadata, not a global literature search or generated findings.

tools.name: get_amir_publication_citation
tools.description: Retrieve one verified bibliographic record by DOI, preserving the full co-author list; missing records are not inferred.
